caption: The drawing depicts a square quilt featuring a repeating geometric pattern composed mainly of star shapes and diamond or square segments. The stars are colored in shades of light purple and pink, with the individual pieces forming each star section clearly outlined. The spaces between the stars are filled with light, off-white or cream-colored diamond or square shapes that have a subtle leaf or feather motif within them. Surrounding the central quilt pattern is a wide border, decorated with light purple and pink vine-like designs and small leaves or petals, which are evenly spaced along the edge. The outer border of the quilt features an additional narrow band with similar small leaf shapes also in purple and pink. The overall composition is symmetrical and exhibits a delicate color palette dominated by purples and pinks, with lighter off-white tones for the background and negative space.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
